page.layout: One page of text in a single column; running head at top with page number at top right; catchword/signature line at foot ("G" centred, "logiæ" at right is a catchword). No margin notes.

main_text.l: tem, felicius suffocavit, quàm, ex Tigurina Schola Theolo-
gica, Zuinglius, Bullingerus, Huldricus? Quis Papùmo
jugulum fortius & certius petiit, quàm idem ille Romani stabuli
eversor Zuinglius? Quis Socinianorum, Arianorum, Serveta-
norum impietates, eo tempore, majori aufu & conatu aggres-
sus est, quàm Wolfius & Simlerus? Quis abstrufa de Præde-
stinatione, Providentia Dei, Cœna Domini, mysteria aper-
tius referavit, adversariorum Sophismata clarius detexit,
quàm malleus ille Heterodoxorum, ipsis Venerabilis Ponti-
ficijs, Martyr? Ad errorum investigandas Origines, an ullus
unquam tanto cum successu & applausu animum appulit,
quanto Hospinianus, & ante ipsum Bullingerus, cujus de hoc
Themate scriptum omnium propemodum eruditorum
puncta tulit? Quibus verborum elegantijs, quo argumento-
rum robore, & phalange, Scripturæ Sacræ authoritatem,
contra temerarias & impias Cochlæi offucias, cum adversa-
rij stupore, asseruit Bullingerus? Quanta Δεινότης & Cicero-
niano plane eloquio de Ecclesia differuit Wolfius? Non ob-
scuro de Schola Pædotribæ, sed Dudithio, Episcopo Quin-
quecclefiensi (quanto prius in castris Philistæis Goliatho! vix
nominetenus ad tempus nostro, turpissimo verò tandem de-
fertori, Antitrinitario) scopuli & scrupuli erant eximendi.
Et cùm infelices Osiandri de justitia, Brentij & Andreæ de Ubi-
quitate & Prædestinatione, Illyrici de peccato Originali, ali-
æque plures Ecclesiam vexâssent controversiæ, quâ demon-
strationum evidentiâ, figmenta illa per Ecclesiæ & Scholæ
Tigurinæ Ministros fuerunt elufa & elifa, absurditâsque eo-
rum in apricum producta? Huberus caput vix effert, Theolo-
gorum Tetrapolitanorum, quos inter erat Stuckius, judicio
cadit. Doctrina Sacramentaria plus forte ex Schola Tiguri-
na accepit lucis, quàm à me, absque suspicione tenerioris in
patriam amoris, possit commemorari. Sed quid singulas Theo-
logiæ

page.notes: Page number "45" is partly damaged; read as 4 with the final digit uncertain. The catchword "logiæ" and signature "G" are at the foot. Some words in the Greek "Δεινότης" are a reading of a damaged Greek word and may be inexact; "Huberus" and "Stuckius" read with some doubt.
